John Deere develops technology and equipment to support food, fiber, and infrastructure needs worldwide. The Embedded Software Engineer will work on an embedded development scrum team to design, develop, test, support, and troubleshoot software for agricultural equipment, with a focus on Precision Ag.

Comp. & Benefits
No H1B
Responsibilities
Be a member of an embedded development scrum team working with multiple stakeholders to build and implement functionality for John Deere agricultural equipment such as In-Field Data Sharing and Logistics
Collaborate with Systems Engineers, Software Architects, and other teams in the John Deere Tech Stack to design, develop, and test software for a broad spectrum of Deere equipment with a focus on Precision Ag
Operate as a member in a scrum team environment on varying projects with and provide work direction for team members
Provide product support and defect triage of those system(s)
